changes.planned: One rescue worker in a matte yellow storm suit and plain white helmet.
changes.observed: One rescue worker remains visible in a saturated yellow storm suit with black reinforced knees and elbows, black boots, and a plain white helmet.

changes.planned: Cold overhead blue work lights, rain-slick steel, one distant lightning exposure.
changes.observed: Cold rectangular deck practicals remain overhead, with rain continuing across the frame and specular reflections on the wet steel deck, suit, helmet, and case. The final frame is not held in the earlier lightning-bright exposure.

changes.planned: Worker ends on the right knee with left fingertips on the strap while the line becomes taut.
changes.observed: The worker ends low on one knee with an outstretched hand maintaining contact with the case. The safety line is fully taut toward upper-left. By the final frame the case is pressed near the railing and visible sliding has nearly stopped, rather than both bodies still moving quickly.

changes.planned: Worker and case slide screen-right toward the railing; safety anchor remains upper-left beside blue containers.
changes.observed: The worker finishes center-right and the case finishes at the far screen-right railing. A fixed blue container wall spans the background, the low railing remains on the right, and the camera stays on the same deck side.

changes.planned: The worker catches the case strap before either the case or the sliding body has stopped.
changes.observed: The worker has reached the case and established contact before it leaves the deck. Whether the worker can secure and pull the case away from the railing remains unresolved.

changes.planned: Red rigid emergency case with two silver latches; black strap caught by the worker's left hand; black safety line at the waist.
changes.observed: The rigid red emergency case retains its rectangular shell and black top strap; one front silver latch is visible while the other side is occluded. The worker has hand contact on the strap or case top. A black waist safety line is taut toward an off-screen upper-left anchor.
